_note: Source of truth for the marketplace. Edit this, then run: node scripts/build-marketplace.mjs (add --pin to move every sha to the current main).

vin-media.description: Make videos, podcasts, dubs, voiced websites, talking avatars, courses, share cards and release notes on your own machine.

vin-robotics.description: Check, view, animate, simulate, replay and film robot models (URDF), make AR files and scan objects into 3D.

vin-ai-eval.description: Test chatbots and agents like software, benchmark a local voice assistant, replay agent sessions and lint skill repos.

skills.name: reel-studio
skills.description: Short voiced motion-graphics videos from a text script, made entirely on your own machine.

skills.name: podcast-studio
skills.description: Two-voice podcast episodes made on your own machine from an article or script: voices, mix, chapters, captions, show notes and an audiogram video.

skills.name: dub-studio
skills.description: Translate and re-voice a video locally with synthetic voices, keeping the music, with bilingual subtitles.

skills.name: site-narrator
skills.description: Give any website a recorded voice with no paid service: record its text locally and play it in the browser.

skills.name: avatar-studio
skills.description: Turn a drawn portrait and a script into a video of that character speaking it, made locally and labelled as computer-generated.

skills.name: talking-head
skills.description: Turn one illustrated portrait into a 3D head for a web page that follows the pointer, blinks and talks.

skills.name: course-studio
skills.description: Turn your documents into a static interactive course site: cited lessons read aloud, quizzes with proof, glossary, search and progress.

skills.name: share-cards
skills.description: Link-preview images and per-page share tags for every page of a website, from one HTML template.

skills.name: changelog-studio
skills.description: A git range becomes checked release notes, a CHANGELOG section, a 30-second release reel and a share card.

skills.name: urdf-doctor
skills.description: Audit and repair URDF robot models, export MJCF, test them in MuJoCo, with a visual 3D report.

skills.name: robot-viewer
skills.description: Turn a URDF robot into one compressed GLB and an embeddable, CSP-safe <robot-viewer> web component.

skills.name: retarget-studio
skills.description: Retarget human motion capture (BVH) onto a URDF robot within its limits, with a side-by-side video.

skills.name: physics-studio
skills.description: A robot plus a plain-language task becomes a narrated MuJoCo physics clip with force overlays and a run log.

skills.name: replay-studio
skills.description: One robot recording (rosbag, MCAP, LeRobot, CSV) becomes a synced replay video and a scrubbable offline viewer.

skills.name: robot-reel
skills.description: Turn a robot description (URDF) and a shot list into a voiced showcase video of the robot, made locally.

skills.name: ar-models
skills.description: Turn 3D models and robot files into AR files phones can place in the room: GLB for Android, USDZ for iPhone.

skills.name: scan-studio
skills.description: A phone video or photo set of an object becomes a 3D model (GLB, optional USDZ) and a report, CPU only. Objects only; captures with detected faces are refused.

skills.name: eval-studio
skills.description: Test chatbots, RAG systems and agents like software: run cases, score answers, compare with the last run, gate CI and read a report.

skills.name: voice-loop
skills.description: Build and benchmark a local voice assistant (VAD, Whisper, any OpenAI-compatible LLM, Kokoro) with per-stage latency.

skills.name: trace-studio
skills.description: Turn an AI agent session into an anonymised replay page and a short narrated summary video.

skills.name: skill-ci
skills.description: GitHub Action and CLI that checks Claude Code skill repos: SKILL.md lint, secrets scan, script safety, media budget.

projects.name: dual-memory
projects.description: Agent memory library: short-term buffer plus long-term SQLite/FTS5 + embeddings with fact superseding, and an honest benchmark.

projects.name: malay-eval
projects.description: Draft evaluation set for LLMs in Bahasa Malaysia and Manglish: comprehension, translation, code-switching, register, local facts, safety and false friends. Run with eval-studio. Cases await native-speaker review.

projects.name: teleop-playground
projects.description: Teleoperate a simulated SO-ARM100 arm in the browser with keys, touch, webcam hand tracking or phone tilt, and record demonstrations. Camera frames never leave the device.

projects.name: open-robot-zoo
projects.description: A gallery of openly licensed robot models with 3D viewers, specs, licences, health checks, clips and AR files, built from pinned sources.

projects.name: physical-ai-radar
projects.description: A weekly, automatically built digest of open robotics and physical-AI releases: models, datasets, tools and papers, with transparent scoring and feeds.

projects.name: policy-from-scratch
projects.description: Imitation-learning robot policies from scratch on CPU (BC, ACT-lite, tiny diffusion) on a MuJoCo push task, with honest paired statistics, ablations and videos. Simulation only.
